description: Village is a mixed-use development with predominantly residential uses interspersed with retail facilities, some commercial offices and community facilities. The development will include a variety of apartment building types. Residential accommodation for middle income, predominantly families, is mainly provided in the form of multi-family apartments, or in units above retail facilities on the ground floor. The project as a whole is conceived as an integrated development, focusing on providing residential accommodation for between 23,000 and 26,000 people.
